events.title: Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour
events.description: Westlife to Trondheim -- June 20, 2027! After selling out Oslo Spektrum in under ten minutes, it's now confirmed that Westlife are also coming to Trondheim. On June 20, 2027, the legendary pop group will take over Sverresborg Museum as part of their anniversary tour, "Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour." The tour marks 25 years since the beginning of the journey for Shane, Nicky, Kian, and Mark, and will be the band's first major European tour in more than 20 years. Fans can look forward to a spectacular show packed with songs that defined a generation -- from timeless ballads to global pop hits. Get ready to sing along to classics like "Flying Without Wings," "Uptown Girl," and "You Raise Me Up," alongside new material from the anniversary album 25 -- The Ultimate Collection. Westlife is one of the most successful pop groups of all time, with more than 55 million albums sold, billions of streams, and sold-out arenas around the world. Since reuniting in 2019, they have performed more than 200 shows across 30 countries -- and now it's Trondheim's turn. This will be a huge summer night filled with nostalgia, massive singalongs, and pure pop magic at Sverresborg. • Date: June 20, 2027 • Venue: Sverresborg Arena, Trondheim • Doors open: TBA • Show starts: TBA • All ages welcome Food & Beverage: Food and alcohol available. Wheelchair/companion: To register a companion in connection with an accessible (HC) space / general admission ticket, please contact hc@trondheimstage.no. Remember to bring a valid, officially issued companion certificate. Companion: Free without a ticket. Wheelchair user: Use password RULLESTOL. Parking: No Tickets will be available as mobile tickets (QR codes) via the Ticketmaster app and your user account well in advance of the concert (about 30 days). Learn more about delayed delivery of admission passes here . Purchased tickets are non-refundable! There is no minimum age for the concert, but children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult. For more information: www.allthingslive.no andwww.trondheimstage.no www.westlife.com
